evals.prompt: Review my branch feature/cox-sensitivity before I open a PR. It changes R/survival_models.R (adds a time-varying covariate Cox model and a Fine-Gray sensitivity analysis), tests/testthat/test-survival.R, and renv.lock. analysis/sap.md exists in the repo. Plan is docs/plans/2026-09-20-001-feat-survival-sensitivity-plan.md.
evals.expected_output: A multi-agent review that announces the team (always-on personas plus R, methods, reproducibility, and SAP-drift conditionals), merges and confidence-gates findings into a P0-P3 report with requirements completeness against the plan, applies only safe_auto fixes, and ends with a verdict.
expectations: Announces the review team and spawns the always-on reviewers (method-correctness-reviewer, method-testing-reviewer, method-maintainability-reviewer, method-project-standards-reviewer, method-learnings-researcher)
Adds conditionals justified by the diff, including method-r-code-reviewer, method-methods-reviewer, method-reproducibility-reviewer, and method-sap-drift-detector (because analysis/sap.md exists)
Findings are grouped by P0-P3 severity in pipe-delimited tables, and findings below confidence anchor 75 are suppressed except P0 at 50+
Includes a Requirements Completeness section against the supplied plan, and ends with a verdict (Ready to merge / Ready with fixes / Not ready)
Does not commit, push, or create a PR unless the user chooses that in the interactive next-step after fixes were applied
Any finding that cites a reporting-guideline item or methods paper names its PMID/DOI source and evidence label rather than quoting the guideline from memory

evals.prompt:
mode:agent base:origin/main
